description: Datadog monitors for the LingQ Reading Engine. All monitors target Prometheus-style metrics exposed by the NestJS backend via OpenMetrics and ingested by the Datadog Agent.

monitors.name: [Reading Engine] No reading sessions started
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No LingQ reading sessions have been started in the last 30 minutes. This could indicate a complete outage of the reading engine or zero user engagement.

**Actions:**
1. Check the NLP service health endpoint.
2. Verify the NestJS backend is running and Supabase connection is healthy.
3. Check for deployment or infrastructure incidents.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [Reading Engine] High AI/NLP error rate
[Reading Engine] AI request latency spike
[Reading Engine] Tokenisation latency high
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
Intl.Segmenter tokenisation is averaging more than 500ms over the last 10 minutes. The tokenisation should be sub-millisecond for typical text. This could indicate a Node.js event loop blockage or extremely large text payloads.

**Current value:** {{value}}s
**Threshold:** 0.5s

**Actions:**
1. Check Node.js event loop lag metrics.
2. Inspect for unusually large text payloads in reading sessions.
3. Verify garbage collection frequency is normal.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [Reading Engine] Low flashcard save rate from reading sessions
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
The ratio of flashcards saved per reading session has dropped below 0.5 over the last hour. This suggests users are not finding new words to save or the flashcard save flow is broken.

**Current ratio:** {{value}} saves/session
**Threshold:** 0.5

**Actions:**
1. Verify the 'save to deck' UI button is functional.
2. Check for errors in the flashcards.createOrUpdateFlashcard endpoint.
3. Inspect whether content difficulty is appropriate for target languages.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [Reading Engine] Daily active readers dropped to zero
[Reading Engine] Words looked up per session declined significantly
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
The average number of word lookups per reading session has dropped below 3 over the last hour. This suggests either content is too simple, users are disengaged, or the word lookup feature is broken.

**Current value:** {{value}} looks/session
**Threshold:** 3

**Actions:**
1. Verify the word click handler is firing correctly.
2. Check the translate endpoint is returning results.
3. Inspect user behaviour analytics for reading sessions.
{{/is_alert}}
